issues.description: The UML/problem statement declares RollerCoaster.numberOfLoopings as type int and requires constructors to accept attributes in the UML-defined order and types, but the Solution's RollerCoaster constructor takes a double parameter (and casts it to int). This constructor parameter type mismatches the UML/specification and will confuse students about the correct constructor signature to implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the RollerCoaster constructor in the solution (and any template guidance) to accept an int for numberOfLoopings (public RollerCoaster(String name, char abbreviation, int numberOfLoopings)) and assign it directly to the int field (this.numberOfLoopings = numberOfLoopings;). This aligns the constructor signature with the UML and removes the unnecessary double parameter and cast.
